entities.name: Silk Road Fashion Exchange
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Silk Road didn't just carry silk — it exchanged fashion. Chinese silk reached Byzantine courts; Persian patterns influenced Chinese design; Indian cotton spread eastward. Mongol Period garments blended styles from Korea to Hungary.
